title: New Moon
author: Stephenie Meyer
summary: After Edward leaves Forks, Bella falls into months of numb grief. She finds comfort in a friendship with Jacob Black, who has secrets of his own.
readIf: you read the first book and want to see what happens next in the series.
skipIf: you have not read Twilight, or you dislike long stretches of sadness in a romance.

pairings.reason: The first book in the series and the place to start.
A teen love story where loss runs through every page.
A romantasy that also follows a heroine through trauma toward a new love.
